answer: Each epoch the registry auctions 100 non-transferable licenses: winners pay a $20 floor fee that is burned, so licenses cannot be resold. Each license carries a unique cedar serial and pigment code on a public list; transactions citing a duplicate or unlisted code are rejected. Licenses expire at epoch end, so an attacker needing 50 fake identities must win 50 licenses for at least 50 x $20 = $1,000; honest agents pay $20 once, keeping a haven fakes cannot outvote. Like 100 numbered grove permits, a forged number fails and buying them all costs more than the harvest is worth.
